text_to_image_prompt: Adult elegant woman, short blonde side-parted bob, blue-gray eyes, pearl drop earrings, black square-neck tailored sheath dress with three-quarter sleeves and below-knee hem, black pumps. Nine frontal head-and-shoulder expressions in a 3 by 3 grid: neutral, warm smile, laugh, skepticism, concern, restrained anger, sadness, surprise, thoughtful listening. Pure white seamless studio background, soft even daylight, natural detailed skin and individual hair strands, accurate cloth weave and shoe leather, realistic photography, no text, no watermark. Maintain natural adult anatomy and consistent identity.
original_prompt: Create a nine-expression casting reference sheet of the exact SAME adult person shown in both references. Adult elegant woman, short blonde side-parted bob, blue-gray eyes, pearl drop earrings, black square-neck tailored sheath dress with three-quarter sleeves and below-knee hem, black pumps. Image 1 is facial identity and image 2 is approved outfit/style. Precisely 3 columns by 3 rows, nine head-and-shoulders photographs, same frontal eye-level camera, scale, hairstyle and outfit. Read left to right, top to bottom: 1 neutral attentive, 2 small warm closed-mouth smile, 3 genuine happy laugh, 4 skeptical raised eyebrow, 5 worried concern, 6 restrained anger, 7 quiet sadness, 8 surprised with slightly parted lips, 9 thoughtful focused listening. Expressions must look like believable live-action acting with subtle eyes and mouth, not exaggerated cartoons. Preserve exact identity, eye color, age, skin texture and all accessories in every cell, including glasses if present. Each complete head and hair has space around it, evenly arranged, no overlap. Pure white background, soft bright studio light, sharp natural photographic detail, no painterly embossed textures, no beauty filters or plastic skin. No captions, labels, watermarks, borders or props. Square reference sheet at maximum available native resolution.
reproduction_note: 独立提示词为成图重建描述；严格身份一致需同时参考已确认全身图与原始肖像。实际尺寸按PNG记录，不冒称2K或4K；背面细节为生成补全。
